name: HISN Health Authority (DoH / DHA) agent

name: HISN Gap Engine (loophole hunt + counterfactual tests)
description: Searches an abstract tactic catalogue for loopholes, re-runs the battery with candidate provisions, measures protection, access and MIZAN.

candidate_provisions.mechanism: Protected (essential) sender IDs accepted only when authenticated by the registered sender
candidate_provisions.comparator: Partly verified: Singapore SRF footnote 9 (Sender ID Registry via licensed aggregators); per-sender cryptographic authentication is HISN's own extension

candidate_provisions.mechanism: Protected sender IDs rejected when arriving via unregistered / foreign aggregator routes
candidate_provisions.comparator: Verified: Singapore SRF 5.2.1-5.2.2 (authorised aggregators) and India TRAI header register (consolidated text)

candidate_provisions.mechanism: Operator filtering duty extended from marketing spam to fraud: payment demands from unregistered senders blocked
candidate_provisions.comparator: Partly verified: Singapore SRF scope covers impersonation scams and 5.2.3 mandates a URL filter on all SMS; a payment-demand duty for unregistered senders is HISN's own variant

candidate_provisions.mechanism: Authenticated essential senders bypass content-based scoring (verified-sender lane); added after the baseline revealed access harms
candidate_provisions.comparator: Inspired by registered / verified sender schemes (verify text)

guardrail: Placeholder message text only; comparators marked verify-text; every patch awaits named human sign-off; sign-off refused without measured evidence.

readiness: D10 (d10_m01 Policy Sandbox, d10_m02 Policy Evaluation, d10_m03 Policy Extrapolation)
